event_summary: A transparent iridescent bubble remains visible against a cloudy sky while its outline, internal color bands, and position change gradually.
raw_event_description: The video shows a single round translucent bubble in front of a blue sky with scattered white clouds. At the start, the bubble is near the upper central area of the frame with a visible circular rim and darker curved band inside. Over time, it stays intact while its rim becomes more circular and the colored highlights on its surface shift. The bubble remains near the central area with small gradual changes in its apparent position relative to the cloud background. No bursting or contact with another object is visible.

reasons: The main bubble is already present at the beginning.
No release point or preceding setup is visible.
The bubble outline and internal colored reflections are visible against the sky.
